This is the Old Shoin only, not an arbitrary pavilion. Exclude garden, trees, later adjoining wing and paths. The last image is ONLY the project's delicate black ink contour STYLE sample; never transfer its subject. Fine sparse accurate black line work, minimal hatching and no large dark fills. Background should be completely blank opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, or preserve native transparency if supplied. Whole subject centered with generous margins.
